title: Horned Figure by Ruins
description: A black silhouette of a horned female figure sits on a stone altar draped in green cloth. Her face shows glowing pink eyes and long flowing pink tears while one hand touches a flowering branch and the other rests on the stone.
prompt: A black silhouette of a horned female figure sits on a stone altar covered in green cloth next to ancient ruins overgrown with green vines. She has glowing pink eyes and long pink tears, one hand touches a branch full of yellow flowers while the other rests on the stone. The scene is set at night with a swirling blue sky, black birds flying, floating bubbles that show small scenes inside, and a body of water below that reflects her image with pink cherry blossoms. Colorful diamond shapes float in the air.
